encounter.summary: Moderate asthma exacerbation after viral URI. Treated with nebulized salbutamol x3 and oral prednisone. Peak flow improved from 52% to 81% predicted.
triggers_reported: new apartment with carpet and cat
encounter.rescue_inhaler_use_reported: using salbutamol 4-5 times per day for 2 weeks

follow_up: See family physician within 1 week. Consider repeat spirometry.
